sources.entry: Correo - Menubar/taskbar Gmail App for Windows and macOS.

summary.one_liner: Correo is an Electron-based desktop app that runs Gmail from the macOS menubar or Windows taskbar.
summary.what_it_does: Wraps Gmail in a desktop window that lives in the macOS menubar or the Windows taskbar and stays in the tray for quick access. It loads Gmail's mobile UI, which the README says suits the small menubar/taskbar window. The README lists Windows and macOS as supported, and says the menubar does not work correctly on Linux. Users can clone the repo and run it with npm, or download a portable build. The project is named after the Spanish word for "mail".
use_cases: run Gmail as a desktop app on Windows
keep email in the system tray
quick mail access without a browser tab
portable Gmail client for Windows or macOS
notable: Gmail runs in a menubar (macOS) or taskbar (Windows) window
Uses Gmail's mobile web UI, suited to a small window
Stays active in the tray for quick use
Portable build offered for Windows, macOS and Linux
caveats: The README says the menubar does not work correctly on Linux, even though a Linux download is listed
Built on Electron and requires Node.js and npm to run from source
Only Gmail is mentioned; no other mail services are named
